title: Review of c01's Marangoni-droplets negative: replicates on fresh seed 3 (alpha=+20: 16 persistent splits vs 6 at alpha=0; no self-propulsion, max 1.4-1.6 BL, a static lattice by t~10000)
summary: Ran the finding's world.py on seed 3 with force scale ampf=0.05 at alpha=+20 and alpha=0 (T=20000; I took ampf to be the 'force scale' of the summary). alpha=+20: two planted droplets throw strong early flows (t=800-2700), split repeatedly (20 splits, 16 persistent, generation 3, 0 merges) and settle into a static hexagonal lattice by t~10000; max 1.4 body lengths at speed <= 0.006. alpha=0: 10 splits, 6 persistent, generation 1, max 1.6 BL at speed <= 0.0015. The fuel-dependent stress raises division and does not make droplets swim, as the finding says.

observations.M: summary.txt: max body lengths 1.4 (alpha +20) and 1.6 (alpha 0), speeds <= 0.006; rerun/a20/seed3/sheet.png: static lattice from t~10000; persistent splits 16 vs 6

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and two of the three arms; alpha=-20 not re-run. The negative is for this operator and parameter range only.
